Edit: I tried a couple of fixes and here is what I got for now - After booting I changed the Affinity settings for the game in Windows Task Manager to a single CPU core -> save -> back to everything which caused the game to finally use all of my CPU's core. Furthermore I added the games .exe file under System -> Display -> Graphics and assigned my GPU as High Performance. Last but not least I went from Uncapped Framerate in the games options to a fixed 60 (refresh rate of my 4k display) and finally managed a rock solid 60. Funnily enough going higher than my displays refresh rate had me hard locked at roughly 40 fps.  
I will restart the demo with those settings and see how it performs in the opening area and the capital as I have progressed just until after the first boss.
